classes.as-is: Runs on a clean machine with only the installed release and a temp directory.
classes.mock: Runs against the drill's mocks: synthetic product checkout and stores, stub tools and loopback stand-ins.
classes.cannot-run: Cannot run off-host; each such row states its reason.

mocks.product-root: Synthetic product Git checkout with its own bare remote, product marker and task records
mocks.fleet-plane: Fleet Comms plane in the synthetic product, seeded with a cto channel
mocks.fixture-store: Synthetic session or tool store built by drill.py
mocks.stub-gh: gh stand-in: fake token, GitHub REST/GraphQL answers framed like gh api --include
mocks.stub-systemctl: systemctl stand-in: units active, dispatch slice loaded
mocks.stub-sudo: sudo stand-in: runs the command as the current user (user-level root stand-in)
mocks.stub-provider-cli: codex, claude, agy, cursor-agent and opencode stand-ins with fixed answers
mocks.stub-backup-script: Product backup script stand-in that only echoes
mocks.sources-standin: Loopback Sources stand-in on 127.0.0.1:8766 (four public VESUM words) plus a declaration-only MCP server file
mocks.synthetic-admission-policy: The public test fixture admission policy, copied into the synthetic product
mocks.fake-credentials: GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN set to a fake value
mocks.no-private-opsec-matcher: The private OPSEC matcher is absent, so public writes must be refused
mocks.stand-in-consumer: A stand-in for a consumer that does not use machinery
